'''Hebsly''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Navy]]. In [[4 ABY]], he was part of a line of [[Imperial officer]]s on board the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] [[superweapon]] that stood by as the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] arrived in one of the [[Battle station|station's]] [[hangar]]s. Hebsley then [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|piloted]] a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]] during the [[Battle of Endor]], in which the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] destroyed the [[Death Star]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Fighters coming in!|[[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] spots the Imperial starfighters at the Battle of Endor|audio=Lando-Fighters-ROTJ.flac|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
Hebsly<ref name="AMG" /> was a [[human]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[pilot]] who served in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Navy]], holding the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Navy's officer corps|officer corps]]<ref name="AMG" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY]].</ref> he<ref name="AMG" /> was among the [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] on board the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] [[superweapon]] while it was under construction in the [[Endor system]]. When the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] arrived on the [[Death Star]] in order to increase the speed of its construction, Hebsly was part of a line of [[Imperial officer]]s who awaited the [[Sith]]'s arrival in one of the [[Battle station|station's]] [[hangar]]s, remaining still as Vader disembarked from his [[ST 321|shuttle]] and greeted [[Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> Jerjerrod matched the gait and rhythm with which Vader had departed when he left the hangar in the hopes that Hebsly and the others present in the hangar would see how aligned and attuned the pair were based on the harmony in the choreography of their parting.<ref name="ROTJ FACPOV">{{StoryCite|story=Any Work Worth Doing|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi}}</ref>

[[File:LieutenantHebsly-SWZ99.png|thumb|250px|left|Hebsly piloted a TIE fighter during the Battle of Endor.]]
After [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] also arrived on the [[Space station|station]], the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|fleet]] of the Rebel Alliance arrived in the Endor [[Star system|system]] to try and destroy the Death Star, falling for a trap that Palpatine had set. Imperial forces surrounded the rebels and [[Battle of Endor|attacked]], but the [[Emperor]] ordered only the Imperial [[starfighter]]s to engage so he might demonstrate the power of the Death Star's [[superlaser]] on the larger [[Starship|ships]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

Hebsly [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|flew]] a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]] during the battle and at one point was tailed through debris by a rebel [[X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="AMG" /> The rebels ultimately claimed victory, destroying the Death Star after the [[death]] of the Emperor.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Hebsly had light skin and [[Color|brown]] [[hair]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Equipment==
While on the Death Star, Hebsly wore a black [[Imperial officer's uniform]] including a black [[belt]], black [[boot]]s, and an [[Imperial kepi]] with an [[officer's disk]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> During the Battle of Endor, the lieutenant flew a [[TIE series|TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]].<ref name="AMG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hebsly first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The scene in which Hebsly appeared was shot on Stage 6 at [[Elstree Studios]] between [[February 22]] and [[February 24]], [[1982]]. The floor of the hangar had to be repainted several times due to the movement and positioning of the various extras on the set, which caused regular damage.<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>

[[File:ReusedHangarFootage-ESB.png|thumb|right|300px|Footage of Hebsly was re-used in the Special Editions release of ''The Empire Strikes Back''.]]
Footage of Vader's arrival on the second Death Star was reused for his return from<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> the [[planet]]<ref name="USWNE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> [[Bespin]] to<ref name="ESB" /> his [[flagship]], the ''[[Executor]]'',<ref name="USWNE" /> in the [[1997]] [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''Special Edition'']] release of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. As such, Mianda's actor is seen in the ''Special Edition'' version alongside other extras who portrayed Imperial officers in ''Return of the Jedi'', however, this article assumes these to be separate characters.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Hebsly's name was first used in a preview for the [[2024]] ''[[Battle Over Endor Scenario Pack]]'' set for [[Atomic Mass Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Second Edition]]'' board game.<ref name="AMG" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Hebsly/Legends|Hebsly]] was first identified in [[2000]] on cards in the "[[Death Star II Limited]]" set for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] published by [[Decipher]]<ref name="CCG1">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Hebsly}}</ref><ref name="CCG2">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Scythe 3}}</ref>
